entrypoints.summary: The stock-check HTTP request accepts the stockApi parameter, which selects the URL fetched by the server.
The product next-product endpoint accepts a path parameter that is placed in a redirect Location header.

observability.channel: HTTP response rendered by the stock checker
negative_controls: Directly changing stockApi to a different host does not cause the server to issue that direct request.
observability.positive_marker: The stock checker shows the internal admin page.

preconditions: The stock checker is restricted against directly requesting a different host.
The application exposes a next-product endpoint whose path parameter is reflected in a redirect Location header.

trigger_steps.summary: Submit a stock-check request with stockApi set to the local next-product endpoint and path set to the internal admin URL.
Change path to the internal admin delete endpoint for the target user.

capabilities.concept: server-side request redirect to internal destination

relation_candidates.dst: server-side request redirect to internal destination
relation_candidates.rationale: The stockApi input is fed to the stock checker, while the local next-product URL can redirect the resulting server-side request.

relation_candidates.dst: server-side request redirect to internal destination
relation_candidates.rationale: The next-product path is placed in the Location header used as the redirect target that the stock checker follows.
The documented server-side redirect reaches and displays the internal administrative page.
relation_candidates.src: server-side request redirect to internal destination

relation_candidates.rationale: The documented redirect reaches the internal admin page and the amended URL invokes the delete-user administrative path.
The lab specifies an admin delete URL with username=carlos as the amended redirect target.
Constraining each effective redirect destination to the authorized destination set would block the documented transition to the private admin URL.
relation_candidates.src: server-side request redirect to internal destination

relation_candidates.rationale: Preventing the next-product endpoint from accepting arbitrary absolute redirect destinations would block the documented redirect chain.
relation_candidates.src: server-side request redirect to internal destination

impact.affected_asset: Internal administrative interface at the lab-specified private address and the user account named carlos.
impact.attacker_capability: Cause the stock-checking server to follow an application open redirect to the specified internal admin URL, including the delete-user endpoint.
impact.security_effect: Server-side request forgery reaches an internal administrative interface and enables an administrative user-deletion request in the lab.

causal_trace.summary: An attacker controls stockApi in the stock-check request and can supply an application-relative next-product URL.

The stock checker rejects a directly supplied different host, but its local-application restriction does not preserve the destination restriction after the allowed local URL redirects through the next-product endpoint.
The server-side stock checker follows the redirect generated from the attacker-controlled path value, reaching the redirected internal administrative URL.
The redirected server-side request displays the internal admin page and can invoke the admin deletion URL for the named user.

failure.operation: Server-side HTTP redirect following from the stock checker to the Location destination controlled through the next-product path parameter.

primary_invariant.statement: Every destination reached by a server-side stock-check request, including redirect targets, must remain within the authorized local-application destination set.
primary_invariant.violated_because: Authorization is effective against a direct different-host stockApi value but the local next-product endpoint can issue an attacker-directed redirect that the stock checker follows.

quality.review_notes: This is a PortSwigger instructional lab and supports the documented HTTP request sequence and stated observables, but the bundle contains no application source, patch, version scope, or independent execution transcript. Remediation is a mechanism-derived mitigation proposal rather than a documented patch.

remediation.invariant_restored: Authorize the effective destination of each stock-check request after redirect resolution, and prevent the next-product redirect from accepting arbitrary absolute destinations.
mitigation_classes: redirect-aware allowlisting of outbound request destinations
elimination or strict validation of attacker-controlled redirect targets

target.component: stock checker and product next-product redirect endpoint
target.project_or_package: PortSwigger Web Security Academy SSRF lab application

oracle.expected_negative: A stockApi value changed directly to a different host is rejected and does not cause the server to issue that direct request.
oracle.expected_positive: A stockApi value using the local next-product redirect endpoint with a path targeting the internal admin URL results in the admin page; the deletion variant targets the named user.
